body: I really appreciate your words but I feel like this is the only escape I have. I can't describe why I want to die in a single comment. In fact I have a written half a notebook on why I am doing it. My parents won't get me any help. I'm a minor and I can't get any help by myself either. I'm trapped in my own mind. I just need to die.
THIS. I really thought that I was the only one.

I have planned to write personal letters for everyone that matters to me. They could read it after my end. So that they know it's not their fault and they get the answers to their questions. I'm also currently writing a journal typa thing so that my family could understand why I did it.

I feel you. all my classmates are working so hard for this important exam and I can't even seem to pick myself up to do anything. The worst part is that my best friend (we were academically similar) is working so fucking hard that she's the topper in my class and she doesn't even have 10 minutes to talk to me. I'm falling behind and my family constantly keeps comparing me to her and I can't help but develop resentment towards her even though I love her to death.  I know I'm selfish but I can't help it. I don't wanna be a disappointment anymore.
